title: The Coming-of-Age Ceremony
summary: Gu Clan guards block Xiao Yan's friends at the ceremony until Mang Tian Chi appears; he is the old man from the Void Lightning Pool and the dean of Jia Nan Academy's Inner Academy. He makes Elder Gu Shan let them pass and says the Xiao Clan's slot in the Heavenly Tomb, long held by the Gu Clan, should be returned. At the ceremony, a star chart measures bloodline from first to tenth rank, and clan marks are granted in silver, gold, purple-gold and rainbow-gold. Ling Quan tests at sixth rank and Gu Yao, a marshal of the Black Submerged Army and an 8-star Dou Zun, at eighth rank. Gu Yao then challenges Xiao Yan, and Mang Tian Chi says surviving a hundred rounds will win back the slot. Xiao Yan's Dragon-Phoenix Ancient Armor takes Gu Yao's blows, and he answers Gu Yao's Ancient Holy Codex with the Five Ring Flame Expelling Formation. When Gu Yao's Great Annihilation Finger breaks through, Xiao Yan strikes back, and Elder Tong Xuan steps in to end the fight.
events: Gu guards bar Xiao Yan's friends from the ceremony.
Mang Tian Chi reveals himself as Dean Mang and makes Gu Shan let them through.
Dean Mang promises help getting the Xiao Clan's Heavenly Tomb slot back.
The bloodline test: Ling Quan sixth rank, Gu Yao eighth rank.
Gu Yao challenges Xiao Yan, who accepts.
The Dragon-Phoenix Ancient Armor withstands Gu Yao's spear.
Gu Yao's Ancient Holy Codex and Great Annihilation Finger against the Five Ring Flame Expelling Formation.
Xiao Yan strikes back and Elder Tong Xuan intervenes.
